note: This is the story closest to existing code traces, but the traces are not functional. The staff UI has a 'Workorder Reports' entry in MetaReport (Report/index.tsx:41-44), a ReportListWorkOrder component with a 1-day filter (ReportListWorkOrder.tsx:36-40) and a grid with columns notice_no, vehicle_no, ref_num, source, is_converted, date_time_received, other_info (:53-68). But the tab sits in a commented-out JSX block (ReportList.tsx:147-201), the grid resource is empty (:48), and the export button code in ActionReport.tsx:88-120 is commented out. The columns (is_converted, date_time_received, ref_num) look copied from another report, not work order content. There is no backend controller for this report (no reports/workorder in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi; api-authorization.properties has no WORKORDER mapping), and no remove/add change or reason data exists to report on. So every step is No code; the stub is not claimed. Story status is blank in stories.json (requirement not given). No matching maintenance ticket (grep work order/warrant/tagging/house visit in maintenance_tickets.csv: 0).
recommendation: Do not claim. Only a hidden, data-less report stub; no working work order report.
